# VPay For Business

> Merchant dashboard to accept NFC tap-to-pay card payments and manage a persistent virtual card balance.

VPay For Business is a single-user merchant app. Payments captured via Stripe Terminal tap-to-pay are automatically loaded onto a "forever" virtual card that the merchant can view and spend.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Merchant dashboard showing virtual card balance, total earned, and quick access to charge customers.
- [Sign In](/auth): Sign in or create a VPay merchant account with email, Google, or Apple.
